input: Apply for a summer internship at a local nonprofit

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Summer Internship at a Local Nonprofit
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a summer internship at a local nonprofit organization.

questions.title: What field or cause does the nonprofit focus on?
questions.description: Understanding the sector (e.g., education, environment, health, social services) helps narrow down target organizations.

questions.title: Do you have a specific nonprofit in mind already?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a target organization or needs to find one shapes the early steps of the plan.

questions.title: What is your intended start date for the internship?
questions.description: Summer timelines vary; knowing the target start month helps set application deadlines.

questions.title: Is this internship paid, unpaid, or for academic credit?
questions.description: Compensation type affects which opportunities to prioritize and how to frame the application.

questions.title: What relevant skills or experience do you bring?
questions.description: Understanding the user's background helps tailor the resume, cover letter, and role targeting.

questions.title: Do you have an updated resume ready to submit?
questions.description: Knowing the current state of application materials determines what preparation steps are needed first.

questions.title: How far are you willing to commute or travel for this?
questions.description: Defining the geographic range clarifies what counts as local and filters eligible organizations.
